description: National infrastructure plans (Planning Administration) is a data set listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by מינהל התכנון. Coverage: Israel. Its title on the portal is "תכניות תשתיות לאומיות" (Hebrew). The portal files it under the publisher מינהל התכנון . Its tags are ותל, לאומית, מינהל התכנון, תכנון, תכנית. The portal shows 2023-03-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency shelter and critical facility planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
